research_question: Can three answer-free relation types remove all four fresh V57 false-action cases while preserving every V57-correct case, with the V57 compiler, frozen model fallback, dataset, and scorer held constant?
project_effect: This is a safety-first repair to the bounded perception-to-action path for a future VRM avatar. It teaches the state representation to distinguish an unselected alternative, a deferred preference, and a polite past description from a current executable request. It does not improve wording, memory, personality, VTuber imitation, or general intelligence.
expected_effect: The six prespecified wrong target commitments should change from requested to ambiguous or mentioned. That should fix exactly four false-action cases, raise V57 ordered exact cases from 54/64 to at least 58/64, raise state commitments from 73/85 to at least 79/85, and introduce no regression. Required-call recall is expected to remain 33/39 in this safety phase; recovering safe fail-closed request misses is explicitly deferred to a separate experiment.
evidence_boundary: This is development on the consumed V57 independent holdout. It may reject V58 or authorize construction of a new independent safety holdout, but cannot provide fresh generalization evidence, runtime readiness, physical safety, complete right-brain quality, or broad human likeness.

causal_isolation.tested_variable: Replace only V56 state resolution with V58's three typed non-execution relations before the same V57 compiler.
held_constant: consumed V57 holdout and item order
grounded candidate ontology and target mention maps
frozen fresh V51 fallback output per target
commitment carrier and deterministic evidence selection
V57 compiler implementation and action allowlist
ordered-call scorer and all gold labels

exclusive_alternative.trigger: At least two distinct supported targets in the same exclusive domain occur in one clause as alternatives marked by Japanese choice morphology such as XかY or どちらか, without an ordered-sequence marker.

deferred_preference.trigger: The utterance expresses a tentative desire about the focus action and also explicitly says the decision is not settled, such as 気もする followed by 決められない.

past_benefactive_description.trigger: The focus action uses unambiguously past benefactive polite morphology such as てくださいました, てくれました, or てもらいました.

candidate_contract.sequence_exclusion: Ordered markers such as まず, 先に, それから, そのあと, 次に, 最後に, and てから must not be classified as alternatives.

failure_routing.partial_fix: Reject this V58 implementation if any prespecified false-action target or case remains. Diagnose the missing relation without sentence-specific patches.
failure_routing.state_regression: Reject V58 immediately if any previously correct target commitment regresses.
failure_routing.call_regression: Reject V58 immediately if any previously exact V57 case becomes incorrect.
failure_routing.coverage_loss: Reject this implementation if required-call recall drops below the frozen V57 value; safety cannot be purchased by suppressing additional valid actions.
failure_routing.pass: Authorize construction of a new independent V58 safety holdout only. The separate explicit-request coverage repair remains unimplemented.
